description: Use to lay out EN 1991-2 notional lanes on a carriageway width, with no model. For CS 454 lanes use cs454_lane_layout; to write lanes and vehicles use ec_moving_loads. Lays out EN 1991-2 lanes on a carriageway cross-section with the Eurocode - Moving Load Wizard's own layout engine: Table 4.1 notional lanes and the remaining area (at one or several placements: against a kerb, the remaining area between two lanes, the lane block at an offset, or swept across), footways, the LM2 axle lane, the LM4 crowd lane, an LM3 special vehicle route and rail tracks, as the chosen loading needs, with each lane's role. Needs no model.

lanes.description: Lane options: prefix (default EC), wheelSpace, optimiseNotional / allowWidth, lm2Manual / lm2Centre, sv / svCentre / svWidth (LM3 route), tracks { tracks, firstTrack, spacing, gauge }, userLanes. Where the notional lanes and the remaining area sit: placements, a list of { packing: LEFT (lanes against the low-offset kerb, the default) | RIGHT (high-offset kerb) | BETWEEN with remBetween k (remaining area between lanes k and k+1) | OFFSET with blockOffset m (lane block that far from the low-offset kerb, remaining area split into REM and REM 2) }, and sweep { on, from, to, step } (the lane block stepped across the remaining area, at most 40 offsets). One placement keeps the plain names (EC L1, EC REM); several, ticked or swept, are each their own lane set (EC A1 L1, EC A2 L1 …) with their own cases (names ending A1, A2 …), never combined in one case. packing alone (LEFT|RIGHT) is still read as one placement.

loading.description: Loading (the plugin's Loading step): disciplines (ROAD, FATIGUE, RAIL), groups (gr1a, gr1b, gr3, gr4, gr5 — the road models follow), roadModels / excludedModels, fatigueModels, railModels, lm3Vehicles, psiValues (CHARACTERISTIC, FREQUENT), factors (alphaPreset EN|UK, alphaQ, alphaq…, footwayCombination), laneLoading, minLoadedLanes / maxLoadedLanes, straddle (MANUAL|ADJACENT), loadRemainingArea, userCases, ieRail…

section.description: Cross-section, m: width (carriageway), kerbOffset, footways, verges, central reserve.

name: ec_lane_layout
title: EN 1991-2 notional lanes for a carriageway
